description: PLATFORM-FIDELITY-01 frozen per-event-pair protocols for the diamond_princess_2020 pair (docs/covid/covid_platform_fidelity_prereg_v1.md). protocols.description: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL for CREW-MESS-01 (docs/covid/covid_crew_mess_01_design.md): verbatim SOP-017-NARROW plus crew_meal_service mode boxed — the documented Diamond Princess response of distributing crew meals rather than seating a communal mess. While the order is active every crew placement resolving into a crew-mess zone resolves to home_zone (mess-posted staff keep their posting: the kitchen still produces the boxes). An intervention arm, not a candidate configuration: it may never score covid.T1/T3/H3 or any other anchor. Trigger unreachable by design; activates only when a scenario schedule names it.
